Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: checking in at reception, waiting arrangements, handing over documents at the front desk.

say what your job was — slot: the job title
say how long you worked there — slot: the length of time
explain what your main duties were — slot: the duty
answer whether you have used a tool or skill — slot: the tool or skill
ask what the main duties are — slot: the position
ask whether training is provided — slot: the skill or task
ask what the next step is — slot: none
must_understand: asks where you worked before and for how long
asks what your main duties were
asks whether you have used a tool or skill before
says what the job involves day to day
explains the next step in the hiring process

partner_lines.text_native: How long did you work there?
Have you used this system before?

topic.description_target: Poți vorbi simplu despre experiența ta și poți înțelege ce include postul.
topic.description_native: You can talk simply about your experience and understand what the job includes.

partner_lines.text_native: How long did you work there?
Have you used this software before?

partner_lines.text_target: Postul include lucru cu clienții, actualizarea stocului și ture de dimineață sau de seară.
partner_lines.text_native: The job includes customer service, stock updates, and morning or evening shifts.

partner_lines.text_target: Următorul pas este un răspuns până luni și, posibil, o probă scurtă.
partner_lines.text_native: The next step is an answer by Monday and possibly a short trial.
